title: Wait time right now, on a ride page

alt.en: The panel at the top of Taron's ride page: a 20-minute wait marked open, today's range and peak, the park's own status and opening hours, the best times left and the typical and busy figures, over a row of five chapter links.

caption.en: Phantasialand, shortly after midday. The panel is the one a park page opens with, filled with a single ride's numbers.
